title: Drill 2026-10-17: crackme with sar
blurb:
# Crackme: find the input (Windows x64, arg in ecx)


89 C8          mov eax, ecx
C1 F8 04       sar eax, 4
83 F0 55       xor eax, 0x55
83 F8 FD       cmp eax, -3
0F 94 C0       sete al
C3             ret


Which 32-bit value of ecx makes the function return 1? Give the smallest (most negative) one in hex.

---

**Answer:** 0xFFFFFA80 (-1408). Any value from -1408 to -1393 works.

1. Work backward: eax ^ 0x55 == -3 (0xFFFFFFFD), so eax = 0xFFFFFFFD ^ 0x55 = 0xFFFFFFA8 (-88).
2. sar is an arithmetic shift: it copies the sign bit and floors toward -infinity, so it discards the low 4 bits. ecx >> 4 == -88 means ecx is in [-88*16, -88*16+15].
3. Opcode C1 /7 ib is SAR (/4 was SHL). shr would fill with zeros and give a different answer for negative inputs.
